title: Study of network security in 2015
author: Rafael Takeshi Sasaki Okida
abstract: This work seeks the analysis of relevant events about network security that happened in 2015, studying its mechanisms and, in some cases, creating demonstrations in the laboratory's controlled environment. The studied cases were the rise of DDoS occurrences, vulnerabilities in the TLS protocol, vulnerabilities in routers and use of NTP servers for attacks with invalid certificates.
